Fabric provides an API endpoint, so enterprise developers can connect their own compatible external AI clients or custom applications to the ontology. It tells useful. However, the current guidance notes a severe limitation. Service principal access is currently unavailable for this endpoint. Explain that for the non -developers. What is a service principal? A service principal is basically a machine identity. It's a non -human service account you use, so a backend server or an automated script can talk to an API securely without needing a human being to physically type in a username and password. Oh, so you can automate it? Right. But because service principal access is missing in this preview, you currently have to authenticate as a real human user. You cannot easily set up a fully automated unattended machine to machine integration. That drastically limits how you can integrate this ontology into automated backend enterprise systems right now.
